DHAKA, Oct 6, 2022 (BSS) - Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina today assured the countrymen that there is nothing to be worried as Bangladesh's economy is in a quite strong position.

"Bangladesh's economy, in terms of midterm and long-term aspects, is at no risk. I can ensure all of you that there is nothing to worry," she said.
